# Sit Stand Stretch

> Sit Stand Stretch is a small set of free web tools for calm breathing, focus and gentle strength. No account is needed, and each tool saves its settings only in the user's own browser.

## Tools

- [Free Easy Breath Tool](https://sitstandstretch.com/breathing): a soft bubble grows and shrinks to guide breathing in, hold and out; includes 4-7-8 relaxation, box breathing, double exhale and a gentle beginner pattern
- [50 Minute Timer](https://sitstandstretch.com/timer): a plain focus countdown for one task at a time; play, pause, reset, adjust the length (1 to 120 minutes) and save your own default
- [Pushup Coach](https://sitstandstretch.com/pushup-coach): a weekly plan that takes you from countertop pushups to full floor pushups, with a weekly test, hard and easy days, a rest timer, a log and a printable PDF plan

## Pages

- [Home](https://sitstandstretch.com/): all tools on one page

## Notes

- Free to use
- Not medical advice. Stop if you feel dizzy or have pain, and ask a doctor or physical therapist before starting new exercises.
- Settings and logs stay in the browser on the user's device; nothing is sent to a server
